sutra.name: Nikhilam Navatashcaramam Dasatah
sutra.description: This sutra is used for subtraction and multiplication of numbers close to powers of 10. It uses the complement concept where you find the difference from the nearest power of 10.

lessons.title: Subtraction Using Complements
lessons.description: Find complement from 10 (for single digits) or 100, 1000, etc.
lessons.content:
## Theory
- Find complement from 10 (for single digits) or 100, 1000, etc.
- Subtract using the complement method

lessons.title: Multiplication by Complements
lessons.description: When numbers are close to powers of 10
lessons.content:
## Theory
- When numbers are close to powers of 10
- Find how much more or less than 10 (or 100, 1000, etc.)
- Use criss-cross method

lessons.title: Division Using Complements
lessons.content:
## Theory
- Division using paravartya technique
- Express dividend and divisor using complements

lessons.title: Chain Operations with Complements
lessons.content:
## Theory
- Combine multiple operations efficiently
- Practical applications in calculations
